title: Highlighted Netherite x Bare Bones
description: Never overlook Netherite / Ancient Debris again... Bare Bones style!
body:
Inspired by the work of users [@jannik6879](https://modrinth.com/user/jannik6879) and [@PrincParshia](https://modrinth.com/user/PrincParshia), this resource pack changes the texture of Ancient Debris to an eye-catching blue color that better matches the art style of the Bare Bones - Emissive Ores resource pack. This pack only changes the texture of Ancient Debris and not Netherite itself. In order to funciton properly, place this pack **above** Bare Bones - Emissive Ores in the resource pack order.

⚠️Emissive and connecting features require Optifine or any CTM port that functions identically. For fabric users, I reccomend [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity).
